text: Assumption: The file lock is released upon destruction of the accessor handle — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The file lock is released upon destruction of the accessor handle — is this correct?
norm: the file lock is released upon destruction of the accessor handle
assumption: The file lock is released upon destruction of the accessor handle.
rationale: The specification requires closing the file when the handle goes out of scope and verifies kResourceBusy for files that are already open.

original.text: Annahme: Freigabe der Dateisperre bei Zerstörung des Accessor-Handles — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Freigabe der Dateisperre bei Zerstörung des Accessor-Handles
original.rationale: Die Spezifikation fordert das Schließen der Datei beim Out-of-Scope-Gehen des Handles und belegt kResourceBusy bei bereits geöffneten Dateien.
